title: [Bookgolas Web Parity 11] Implement email authentication, verification and recovery
declared_commit: feat(auth): add email login signup and recovery

red.scenario: The exact auth-email acceptance contract is absent before implementation.
red.observable: Exit 1 with npm error: Missing script: test:auth-email.

criteria.scenario: Localized signup validates nickname and sends nickname metadata through Supabase Auth.
criteria.observable: The ko signup test displays the required nickname error, submits data.name, reaches the confirmation state, and the command exits 0 with 3 passed.

criteria.scenario: Login saves only an opted-in email, follows the safe localized destination, and logout clears browser/server session behavior.
criteria.observable: The login test reaches /en/home, observes the Supabase logout request, finds no auth-token cookie, then receives the server redirect to sign-in after the fixture session is removed; saved email remains populated.

criteria.scenario: Forgot-password stays non-enumerating and an authenticated recovery session updates the password then signs out.
criteria.observable: The recovery test shows the same if-account-exists response, submits the recover request, updates the password with a persisted Supabase session, signs out, and exits in the localized success state.

criteria.scenario: Invalid credentials do not reveal whether an account exists.
criteria.observable: The ko invalid test renders the combined email-or-password error and the failure command exits 0 with 2 passed.

criteria.scenario: An unconfirmed email exposes resend with a deterministic 60-second cooldown.
criteria.observable: The en unconfirmed test renders localized guidance, fulfills the Supabase resend request, and observes a disabled countdown button.

criteria.scenario: Every ko/en login, signup, and reset page remains legible at 375, 768, and 1280 widths in light and dark themes.
criteria.observable: 36 Chromium responsive cases pass and produce 36 viewport-sized PNG captures.

green.observable: auth-email contract PASS; 2 files and 35 tests passed; exit 0.

verification.invocation: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
verification.observable: TypeScript and ESLint exit 0; Vitest reports 20 files and 161 tests passed; all parity/negative/render scripts pass; Next production build compiles and generates all existing admin, legal, marketing, consumer, and auth routes.

review.observable: The final scoped diff has no whitespace errors, no unrelated route changes, no password persistence, no account-existence copy, no unsafe redirect expansion, and no client secret exposure.

cleanup.observable: Port 3000 and the loopback fixture port 54329 have no listeners; no Next or Playwright process references the task worktree; git diff --check passes.
